inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Nutrition and Food Service - No Beverages with Added Sugar, unless allowed by CACFP: Chocolate milk was served to children during lunch.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Nutrition and Food Service - No Beverages with Added Sugar, unless allowed by CACFP (26 TAC §744.2401(g))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A staff member that was present and in direct contact with children had an inactive background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Procedures parents access minimum standards online, TX A/N hotline, and HHSC website: Instructions on how parens can access the Minimum standards online, Texas Abuse and Neglect Hotline; and HHSC website need to be added to the operation's policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures parents access minimum standards online, TX A/N hotline, and HHSC website (26 TAC §744.501(20))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: Tweezers are needed for the program's first aid kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §744.2753(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Procedure for Parents Review of Policies: Procedures for parents to review and discuss with the director any questions or concern about policies and procedures needs to be added to policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Procedure for Parents Review of Policies (26 TAC §744.501(18))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: This standard was reviewed for this investigation.  Based on the information provided, the incident/illness report wasn't shared with the parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §744.707)

occurrences.finding: Field Trips - Emergency Medical Forms: Based on the information received during the investigation the summer camp didn't take the required emergency contact information on the field trip.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Field Trips - Emergency Medical Forms (26 TAC §744.2301(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: This standard was reviewed for this investigation.  Based on the information received during the investigation, the parent informed the director on 6/27/2025 that the child was being taken for medical attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §744.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption with HS Diploma/GED: Documentation needs to be provided that staff under 18 are partcipating in a child care career program at their high school needs to be provided.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption with HS Diploma/GED (26 TAC §744.1107(a))

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912): 3 staff members don't have a completed preemployment affidavit form for their employment file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §744.1103(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Current Driver's License: 3 staff members need a copy of their photo id for their staff file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Orientation Completed (26 TAC §744.901(10))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care: The facility where the program is housed doesn't have a current fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care (26 TAC §744.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements- Letter or form from the most recent licensing inspection or investigation.: The program doesn't have the most recent inspection form posted in the Licensing binder for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements- Letter or form from the most recent licensing inspection or investigation. (26 TAC §744.401(2))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: A first aid and emergency guide, antispetic solution or wipes, and tweezers are needed for the camp's first aid kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §744.2753(a))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Change in Space: The camp is using a space that Licesning wasn't notified of or permitted for use.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Change in Space (26 TAC §744.301(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-phone number parents may be reached: 2 children need addresses for emergency contacts on admission form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-phone number parents may be reached (26 TAC §744.605(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care: The operation doesn't have a current fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care (26 TAC §744.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Physician Information: 1 child needs healthcare information for admission form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Physician Information (26 TAC §744.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: It wasn't reported to Licensing that the operation sustained damage to the camp's primary space of the gym during the last major storm rendering it unsafe for use.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence (26 TAC §744.305(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: In reviewing emergency practices documentation there is no documentation that a fire drill has recently been practiced by the operation while operating over the holiday break required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §744.3559(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Emergency Medical Authorization: 10 child files were reviewed during today's inspection.  1 child file needs information for emergency medical authorization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §744.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Emergency Contact: 10 child files were reviewed during today's inspection.  2 child files need addresses for emergency contacts. 1 child needs emergency contact information for admission form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Emergency Contact (26 TAC §744.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: 5 staff files were reviewed during today's inspection.  1 staff member needs employee affidavit to be signed and notarized.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (26 TAC §744.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: The governing body isn't complyin with rules and laws by making sure that all staff have eligible backgrounds before allowing staff at the opertion.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §744.201(9))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver that has a pending background was present at the program without a clear background.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
